title: Joel — bump map holographic demo
note: Borderline: she asked how he did it, not to save it — filed here as the technique breakdown she requested. Joel's bump map holographic demo: not WebGL, not a real hologram. A flat 320px card (5/6 aspect, pink #fb7185) with 3 stacked images (flat silhouette, grayscale height map, grayscale shading map) + 2 SVG filters + a moving point light. Honest gaps: the page never says how the depth maps were made, and there is no repo. Offered to build her a version with one of her drawings; unanswered.
